name: Tessellis S.p.A.
summary: Tessellis S.p.A. is a prominent telecommunications firm operating in Italy, offering a diverse array of services. Its core offerings include high-speed internet solutions such as broadband, ultrabroadband, fixed wireless access (FWA), and cutting-edge fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) connectivity. Beyond internet access, the company delivers fixed-line and mobile communication services, along with various value-added features, to a broad clientele encompassing households, businesses, and public administrations. Expanding its operations, Tessellis also manages online newspaper platforms, digital shopping portals, and provides advertising services. The company, initially established as Tiscali Spa in 1998, rebranded as Tessellis S.p.A. in January 2023 and is based in Cagliari, Italy.
